The two database reads below them were stubbed (0x2904d90 returning Result<Option<U256>>, 0x46541b0 or 0x477d590 returning Result<U256>). 311 cases, 1967 checks after commit or revert, 916 reverts, 740 commits, 0 mismatches, 0 stops, 0 pyevm mismatches on 0x5a0fc58 and 311 cases, 2106 checks after commit or revert, 1006 reverts, 789 commits, 0 mismatches, 0 stops, 0 pyevm mismatches on 0x5a0f458 matched the revm rules and pyevm. 0x2d06750 is discard_tx (revm-context 43.0.3 journal/inner.rs lines 174-200): after each case it left journal length 0, depth 0, the transaction id one higher, every slot at its loaded value and every transient word zero; planted faults that skip the transient clear or the entry revert were caught. A failed transaction therefore leaves no unlock flag, delta or count for the next one (PoolManager.sol:104-114).
